calls.bash: eval "$(mu agent remote-env w1 -w eval --shell)"; ssh dev "tmux new-session -d -s mu-w1 -c ~/ws/w1 '$MU_REMOTE_ENV \$SHELL -ilc \"pi --approve\"'"
eval "$(mu agent remote-env w1 -w eval --shell)"; mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --command "ssh $MU_SSH_ARGS dev -t 'tmux attach -t mu-w1'"
mu task claim s1 -w eval --for w1 --evidence 'remote on dev'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --fresh --json 'do s1; mu is not on this host'
mu task close s1 -w eval --evidence 's1 worker finished on dev (DONE: s1)'
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi
git fetch "ssh://dev/~/ws/w1" HEAD && git cherry-pick FETCH_HEAD
eval "$(mu agent remote-env w1 -w eval --shell)"; mu agent spawn w1 -w eval --command "ssh $MU_SSH_ARGS dev -t 'tmux attach -t mu-w1'"
mu task claim s2 -w eval --for w1 --evidence 'remote on dev'
mu agent send w1 -w eval --json 'do s2; mu is not on this host'
mu task close s2 -w eval --evidence 's2 worker finished on dev (DONE: s2)'
rev=$(mu agent close w1 -w eval | sed -n 's/.*--if \([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1); if [ -n "$rev" ]; then mu agent close w1 -w eval --if "$rev"; fi
git fetch "ssh://dev/~/ws/w1" HEAD && git cherry-pick FETCH_HEAD
ssh dev 'tmux kill-session -t mu-w1; git -C ~/repo worktree remove ~/ws/w1'

text: s1 and s2 ran on dev one after the other and both commits are on main.
